Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target After Stock Selloff
videos.description: Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for the second time in about two months in the wake of a powerful stock selloff that pushed the benchmark into a technical correction. The president and chief investment strategist of Yardeni Research Inc. sees the index closing out 2026 at 7,500 points, down from the reduced target of 7,900 he projected in September. That would still represent a recovery of more than 8% for US stocks from where they ended on Friday. For details, Bloomberg's Nathan Hager speaks with Ed Yardeni of Yardeni Research. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: What’s Next for AI Trade & Asia Tech Stocks?
videos.description: James Sullivan, Co-Head of Global Fundamental Research at JPMorgan, says Asian AI stocks are pricing in earnings cuts of as much as 30%, while the firm sees about 5% as realistic. On Bloomberg's Insight with Haslinda Amin, he discussed the recent tech selloff, as well as his outlook for Fed policy. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
